Library Furniture Production Process

1. Concept & Design

We define display needs, layout, and style, then create design plans and 3D visuals.

2. Material Selection

We choose durable materials such as wood, metal, or mixed structures based on project requirements.

3. Precision Processing

CNC cutting and fabrication ensure accurate dimensions and smooth finishes.

4. Surface Finishing

Coating, painting, or powder finishing improves durability and appearance.

5. Assembly

All components are assembled into stable structures with functional display tiers.

6. Quality Inspection

Each unit is checked for structure, finish, and load performance.

7. Packaging & Shipping

Products are securely packed and prepared for safe international delivery.

8. Support & Service

We provide installation guidance and reliable after-sales support.

Certified to international standards: FSC, BSCI, SGS.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you support bulk and wholesale orders?

Yes. We specialize in wholesale library furniture and bulk commercial orders for distributors, contractors, educational institutions, and project-based clients.

Do you support international shipping?

Yes. We support global shipping for library furniture projects, including export packaging, container loading, and international logistics coordination.

What is your production lead time?

Production time depends on product specifications, customization requirements, and order quantity. Most commercial furniture orders are completed within several weeks after confirmation.

What types of library furniture do you manufacture?

We manufacture a wide range of commercial library furniture, including library bookshelves, reading tables, magazine display racks, wall shelving systems, children’s library furniture, and modular storage solutions.

What materials are used for your library shelving systems?

Our library shelving is produced using durable commercial-grade materials such as wood, plywood, MDF, laminate finishes, and metal structures designed for long-term use.

Can your furniture be customized for different spaces?

Yes. Our custom library furniture can be tailored for schools, public libraries, bookstores, universities, and commercial reading spaces based on layout and functional requirements.

Do you support custom library furniture projects?

Yes. We provide complete library furniture solutions with custom sizes, finishes, configurations, and layout planning support for commercial projects.

Do you offer OEM & ODM services?

Yes. We offer professional OEM & ODM furniture manufacturing services for wholesalers, retailers, distributors, and commercial project buyers worldwide.

Can you provide furniture for schools and universities?

Absolutely. We supply school library furniture and university library furniture designed for educational environments, study spaces, and collaborative learning areas.
